note: Official catalogue. No weights are stored in this repository; they are downloaded from the official distribution point on first use and checked against the pinned sha256. An entry is 'verified' only when its license evidence is primary (license file, model card metadata or an author statement on the author's own repository) and clean (use and redistribution allowed, no usage restriction). Evidence was re-checked on the date given in each entry. See docs/SPEC.md section 12.

evidence.note: Primary MIT grant permits use, modification and redistribution subject to notice retention.
License section explicitly covers all code AND model weights in the repository under MIT or Apache-2.0.

caveats: These candidates are all trained on conversational speech; singing, instruments and mixes are unsuitable and musical content may be removed as noise. Use only for narration, dialogue or raw vocal recordings.
Training-data provenance is not a guarantee of suitability or rights in a user recording.
Channels are processed independently. Fixed ONNX chunks reset recurrent state with 100 frames of warmup; chunking is part of this adapter version.
